manifest.name: @fg-lab/amadeus-qq
manifest.description: Amadeus QQ continuous interaction plugin for DeepSeek Harness

bundle.text:
# Real OneBot connectivity is disabled until an administrator configures it.
- insert:
    - id: amadeus-qq
      name: '@fg-lab/amadeus-qq'
      config:
        enabled: false

# Dedicated DSH Agent preset shipped by the same @fg-lab/amadeus-qq package.
# It declares only the QQ platform operation contract (tool boundary) and no
# persona or character card. The guard lives with the preset, so a persisted QQ
# Session keeps its tool boundary even when the connector is disabled or absent.
- insert:
    - id: preset-amadeus-qq
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: amadeus-qq
        name: Amadeus QQ
        description: Restricted continuous QQ conversation Session
        order: 20
        plugins:
          - id: qq-tool-boundary
            # Mount the package root here. DSH's preset registry resolves the
            # package root reliably; a package subpath export imports under
            # plain Node but leaves this row "never started" in the registry.
            name: '@fg-lab/amadeus-qq'
            config:
              presetGuard: true
    - id: preset-amadeus-qq-search
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: amadeus-qq-search
        name: Amadeus QQ Search
        description: Restricted QQ conversation with the Host web search boundary
        order: 21
        plugins:
          - id: qq-web-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              search: true
              fetch: false
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          - id: qq-search-boundary
            name: '@fg-lab/amadeus-qq'
            config:
              presetGuard: true
              allowSearch: true
    - id: preset-amadeus-qq-media
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: amadeus-qq-media
        name: Amadeus QQ Media
        description: Restricted QQ conversation with an enhanced media read boundary
        order: 22
        plugins:
          - id: qq-media-boundary
            name: '@fg-lab/amadeus-qq'
            config:
              presetGuard: true
              level: 2
    - id: preset-amadeus-qq-media-search
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: amadeus-qq-media-search
        name: Amadeus QQ Media Search
        description: Restricted QQ conversation with enhanced media read and Host web search
        order: 23
        plugins:
          - id: qq-media-web-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              search: true
              fetch: false
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          - id: qq-media-search-boundary
            name: '@fg-lab/amadeus-qq'
            config:
              presetGuard: true
              level: 2
              allowSearch: true
    - id: preset-amadeus-qq-owner
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: amadeus-qq-owner
        name: Amadeus QQ Owner
        description: Restricted Owner workspace; selected only for a trusted Owner Agent Scene
        order: 24
        plugins:
          - id: qq-owner-boundary
            # Level 4 guards the QQ tool surface. The Owner workspace tool is
            # mounted only after an operator supplies ownerWorkspaceRoot; until
            # then Settings shows it as pending and no file tool exists.
            name: '@fg-lab/amadeus-qq'
            config:
              presetGuard: true
              level: 4
          - id: owner-tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
          - id: owner-tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: owner-tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          - id: owner-tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: owner-tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              search: true
              fetch: true

readme.text: [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Detailed configuration](REFERENCE.md) · [Issues](https://github.com/jeskoky-pixel/amadeus-qq/issues) QQ conversations with persistent DSH Sessions and explicit Scene permissions. Target package: **`@fg-lab/amadeus-qq@1.2.1`**. Tested runtime baseline: official DSH Desktop **0.2.1-rc.3**. MIT licensed.

**1.2.1 is published:** [GitHub Release](https://github.com/jeskoky-pixel/amadeus-qq/releases/tag/v1.2.1) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fg-lab/amadeus-qq). Install the pinned version and verify the release checksum. Later main changes do not change this immutable archive. See [publishing policy](docs/PUBLISHING.md).

- Connect an existing local NapCat instance to authorized groups and private chats, each with a persistent DSH Session in your Workspace.
- Continue a current conversation using read, wait, mark-read and guarded sends; deduplicate delivery attempts and preserve Session history across ordinary configuration edits.
- Handle supported text, mentions, replies and media through capability-specific checks. Provider-dependent features remain conditional.
- Choose Observe, Safe Chat, Enhanced or Autonomous Social presets; trusted administrator private chats may use Owner Agent. Global denials and QQ platform permissions always apply.
- Manage account/profile operations and optional QQ Space capabilities on their separate account page. Availability depends on the actual provider and configured grants.
- Pause NapCat listening for handoff to another application. QQ owns current conversations; optional Life owns long-term wake scheduling.

Example: authorize a test group in Observe, inspect inbound status, then select Safe Chat when ready to allow replies. Use the Web Console to inspect effective permissions instead of assuming that a preset grants every tool.

NapCat is not bundled: this plugin does not install, log in to or host NapCat. An unconfigured installation sends nothing. Dangerous tools are not enabled by default. Memory, Life, State and Persona are optional; QQ does not grant access to their private data merely by receiving a message.

Install the prebuilt `.tgz` with the official DSH plugin manager into your selected Profile. No local source build is required. Follow [installation instructions](docs/INSTALL_V1_2.md); do not copy configuration into a running Profile by hand.

Connect NapCat, choose a Workspace, set the Owner QQ number and authorize individual Scenes. Start with Observe.

The other Amadeus plugins are optional. Install only the integrations you need.
This is a recorded interface screenshot, not evidence that every real platform capability passed the current release gate. See the detailed reference and verification reports for limitations.

Back up user data before upgrading. Code, persistent user data and recovery backups are separate. Disable stops functionality; uninstall is intended to retain external data. Restoring old code alone does not reverse a database migration.

- [Upgrade policy](docs/UPGRADE_POLICY.md)
- [Data migration and recovery](docs/DATA_MIGRATION.md)
- [Release checklist](docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md)
- [Full configuration and limitations](REFERENCE.md)
[English](README.md) · [详细配置参考](REFERENCE.md) 通过持久 DSH 会话与明确的场景权限连接 QQ。 目标发行包：**`@fg-lab/amadeus-qq@1.2.1`**。已验证的官方 DSH Desktop 基线：**0.2.1-rc.3**。许可证：MIT。
已发布 **1.2.1**：[GitHub Release](https://github.com/jeskoky-pixel/amadeus-qq/releases/tag/v1.2.1) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fg-lab/amadeus-qq)。请安装固定版本；发行包校验值见 Release。后续源码修改不代表该版本安装包发生变化。

- 将已登录的本地 NapCat 接入获授权的群聊与私聊，每个场景在指定工作区拥有独立持久 DSH 会话。
- 用读取、等待补充、标记已读和受权限约束的发送维持当前交流；去重投递，普通配置修改保留会话历史。
- 支持代码已实现的文字、@、引用及媒体能力，逐项检查权限；依赖 Provider 的功能以实际可用状态为准。
- 选择仅观察、安全聊天、增强对话或自主群友；仅可信管理员私聊可选择 Owner Agent。全局拒绝与 QQ 平台权限始终有效。
- 在独立账号页管理资料及可选 QQ 空间能力；是否可用取决于实际 Provider 与授权。
- 暂停监听以交接给其他应用。QQ 负责当前交流，可选 Life 负责长期自主唤醒。

示例：先把测试群加入仅观察模式，确认入站正常，再切换安全聊天允许回复。通过控制台查看有效权限，不要把选择预设理解为开放全部工具。

插件不包含 NapCat，不负责其安装、登录或托管。未配置时不会外发，危险工具不默认开放。Memory、Life、State、Persona 均为可选联动，收到 QQ 消息不代表获得其他插件的私有数据权限。

使用官方 DSH 插件管理器将预构建 `.tgz` 安装到所需 Profile，无需手工构建源码。按[安装说明](docs/INSTALL_V1_2.md)操作，不要手工改写正在运行的 Profile。

配置 NapCat、选择工作区、填写管理员 QQ 号并逐项授权场景。建议先选择仅观察。

其他 Amadeus 插件均为可选联动，按需要分别安装。
截图展示已有界面，不表示本轮所有真实平台能力均已通过。具体限制请阅读配置参考和验收报告。

升级前备份用户数据。程序、持久数据和恢复备份分开保存。禁用停止功能；卸载默认保留外部数据。回退旧程序不能自动撤销数据库迁移。
